title.ko: 건강 습관과 조언: 빈도 부사 · should · how often
title.en: health habits and advice: frequency adverbs, should, how often

explain.ko: 건강 습관을 말할 때는 현재 시제와 빈도 부사(always, usually, often, sometimes, occasionally, rarely, never)를 씁니다. 빈도 부사는 be동사 뒤, 일반동사 앞에 놓습니다(I usually sleep seven hours. She is often tired). 횟수는 three times a week처럼 말하고, 질문은 How often ...?입니다. 건강에 좋다 / 나쁘다는 be good / bad for your health로, 조언은 should (not) 또는 It's a good idea to ...로 말합니다.
explain.en: Talk about health habits with the present simple and frequency adverbs (always, usually, often, sometimes, occasionally, rarely, never). Put them after be and before main verbs (I usually sleep seven hours. She is often tired). Say numbers of times like three times a week; ask How often ...? Use be good / bad for your health, and give advice with should (not) or It's a good idea to ...

notes.ko: 빈도 부사의 위치: be동사 뒤, 일반동사 앞.
notes.en: Frequency adverbs go after be and before the main verb.

notes.ko: never는 이미 부정이므로 not과 함께 쓰지 않습니다.
notes.en: Never is already negative, so don't add not.

notes.ko: a week처럼 정관사 대신 a를 써서 '~당'을 나타냅니다.
notes.en: Use a(n) for 'per': three times a week.

HEALTH COLUMN
Many office workers sit for long hours these days. Research shows that standing up and walking for a few minutes once an hour helps your health. You should also drink eight glasses of water a day and eat regularly.

prompt.ko: 나의 건강 습관과 개선할 점을 빈도 부사와 should를 사용해 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about your health habits and what to improve, using frequency adverbs and should.

task.model: I exercise three times a week and usually sleep seven hours. But I occasionally stay up late, so I feel tired. Stress is bad for your health, so I should go for walks more often. I should also avoid sugary food.

model_trans.ko: 나는 일주일에 세 번 운동하고 보통 7시간을 자요. 하지만 가끔 밤늦게까지 깨어 있어서 피곤해요. 스트레스는 건강에 나쁘기 때문에 더 자주 산책을 해야 해요. 또 단 음식을 피하는 게 좋아요.
model_trans.en: I exercise three times a week and usually sleep seven hours. But I occasionally stay up late, so I feel tired. Stress is bad for your health, so I should go for walks more often. I should also avoid sugary food.
